title: How to Get Back Disappeared Candles on Tradingview, Unhide Candlesticks Easily 2026
description:
Here I will show you How to- Get it Back Disappeared Candles on Tradingview 

In today's video, I'm going to teach you how to get it back when your candles have disappeared on TradingView. If you're a regular user of TradingView for monitoring financial markets, you might encounter a situation where the candles on your chart seem to have vanished. This can be perplexing, especially if you're analyzing trends or making important trading decisions. But don't worry, I'm here to guide you through this issue smoothly and effectively.

First, head over to tradingview.com and log into your account. If you haven't signed up yet, take a moment to create an account. Once you're logged in, navigate to the chart section where you're experiencing the problem. If you've loaded your chart and notice that the candles are missing, it might initially seem like a glitch. However, there's a simple, often overlooked solution.

On the chart, look towards the right toolbar, which includes the object tree and data window—useful tools for managing and customizing your charting experience. Pay close attention to the eye icon next to the symbol's name. This icon resembles an open eye and serves as a visibility toggle for various elements on your chart. If your candles have gone missing, it's highly possible that their visibility was accidentally turned off. Simply click on this eye icon next to the symbol's name. By doing this, you reactivate the visibility of the candles on your chart, much like pulling back curtains to reveal what's behind them.

After adjusting the visibility using the eye icon, return to your chart view. You should now see the candles reappear as they were before they disappeared. This simple fix of toggling the visibility feature is often the underlying cause of this issue, and resolving it takes just a matter of seconds. This quick solution not only saves you from unnecessary frustration but also allows you to continue your trading analysis without further interruption.

Remember, TradingView offers many customizable features, and sometimes an accidental click can alter a setting like candle visibility. Always check the visibility settings if other elements seem to be missing. By understanding these basic tools and settings, you're better equipped to handle any quirks that arise during your TradingView experience.

Thank you for watching, and happy trading. If you found this video helpful, be sure to like and subscribe for more tips and tricks."

title: How to Create Horizontal Scrolling Images in Squarespace 2026, with Auto Play & Thumbnails
description:
Here I will show you How to Create Horizontal Scrolling Images in Squarespace 2026, with Auto Play & Thumbnails.

"In today's video, I'm going to teach you **how to create horizontal scrolling images in Squarespace**. If you've ever wondered how to make your website more dynamic and visually stimulating, adding a horizontal scrolling image gallery could be the perfect touch. It's an excellent way to display your portfolio, feature products, or share any collection of images in an interactive and engaging format. Let's dive right into this simple and effective process.
 

 First off, you'll need to log into your Squarespace account. On the login page, click the login button and select ""Continue with Google"" to swiftly sign in using your existing Google credentials. Once logged in, you'll be directed to your dashboard, where you'll see a list of your existing websites. Click on the website you plan to modify or add images to, which will open the editing interface tailored to your particular site.
 

 Now, let's move to the editing process. Start by navigating to the edit option on your Squarespace menu. Once you've opened the editing tools, your next step is to add a new section. Click on ""Add Section"" in your page editor to access a variety of customizable sections. To include images, click on the ""Images"" tab. This feature is your gateway to creating a new scrolling gallery.
 

 Select ""Gallery View"" from the available options to ensure your images are organized in an attractive and accessible format. Moving forward, click on ""Edit Section"" to fine-tune the settings of your image gallery. In the editing options, navigate to the ""Grid"" simple dropdown. From this menu, choose ""Slideshow Simple."" This setting will transform your grid layout into a sleek slideshow format perfect for horizontal scrolling.
 

 Next, enhance the functionality of your gallery by turning on the thumbnails option. Thumbnails provide a preview of each image, allowing visitors to browse through your gallery quickly and efficiently. To make your gallery truly come to life, click on the autoplay option. Enabling autoplay ensures your slideshow progresses automatically, without needing manual navigation from your website visitors.
 

 Lastly, to ensure the pacing of your slideshow suits your audience, scale down the slide duration to keep the experience engaging. Adjusting the duration helps create a delightful viewing rhythm that enhances the visitor experience.
 

 And there you have it! You've successfully created a horizontally scrolling image gallery on your Squarespace site. This captivating feature not only adds a dynamic visual element to your site but also enriches how your audience engages with your content. Thanks for watching, and happy creating!"
